text: マゴの　おむこに　ほしいほどじゃ

structure.en: as a husband for my granddaughter
I'd want him, that's how much

patterns.name: 〜ほど
patterns.explanation: ほど says 'to the point that': it shows how far a feeling goes. ほしいほどじゃ = 'so much that I'd want him'.

patterns.name: 〜に (as)
patterns.explanation: に before ほしい says what role you want someone for: 'as'. おむこに　ほしい = 'want him as a husband'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man form of だ, 'is'. ほどじゃ = 'it is that much'.
